title: Detailed rocket ship
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Main body -->
  <path d='M50 8 C50 8 38 20 36 35 L36 68 L64 68 L64 35 C62 20 50 8 50 8Z' fill='#e8e8f0' stroke='#9090a8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Nose cone highlight -->
  <path d='M50 8 C50 8 43 17 41 28 L50 28 L59 28 C57 17 50 8 50 8Z' fill='#ff4d4d'/>
  <path d='M50 12 C50 12 45 19 44 27 L50 27 L56 27 C55 19 50 12 50 12Z' fill='#ff8080' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Body stripe -->
  <rect x='36' y='45' width='28' height='6' fill='#4da6ff' rx='1'/>
  <rect x='36' y='44' width='28' height='2' fill='#80c4ff' opacity='0.6' rx='1'/>
  <!-- Window / porthole -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='7' fill='#2d2d4a' stroke='#7a7a9a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='7' fill='none' stroke='#aaccee' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='34' r='2.5' fill='#88bbee' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Lower body detail lines -->
  <line x1='40' y1='54' x2='60' y2='54' stroke='#9090a8' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='40' y1='58' x2='60' y2='58' stroke='#9090a8' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='40' y1='62' x2='60' y2='62' stroke='#9090a8' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <!-- Left fin -->
  <path d='M36 52 L22 72 L36 68 Z' fill='#ff4d4d' stroke='#cc3333' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M36 56 L26 70 L36 66 Z' fill='#ff8080' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Right fin -->
  <path d='M64 52 L78 72 L64 68 Z' fill='#ff4d4d' stroke='#cc3333' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M64 56 L74 70 L64 66 Z' fill='#ff8080' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Center fin (back) -->
  <path d='M48 68 L50 82 L52 68 Z' fill='#cc3333'/>
  <!-- Engine nozzle -->
  <path d='M42 68 L40 76 L60 76 L58 68 Z' fill='#8888aa' stroke='#6666aa' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <rect x='42' y='76' width='16' height='3' fill='#aaaacc' rx='1'/>
  <rect x='44' y='76' width='12' height='2' fill='#ccccdd' opacity='0.5' rx='1'/>
  <!-- Flames -->
  <path d='M43 80 Q45 92 50 96 Q55 92 57 80 Z' fill='#ffcc00'/>
  <path d='M45 80 Q47 89 50 93 Q53 89 55 80 Z' fill='#ff9900'/>
  <path d='M47 80 Q48 85 50 89 Q52 85 53 80 Z' fill='#ffee66'/>
  <!-- Small flame sparks -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='94' r='1.5' fill='#ffcc00'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='95' r='1.2' fill='#ff9900'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='97' r='1' fill='#ffee66'/>
  <!-- Antenna on top -->
  <line x1='50' y1='8' x2='50' y2='2' stroke='#c0c0d8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='2' r='2' fill='#ffcc00'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='2' r='1' fill='#ffee88'/>
</svg>
